# How much of the world’s work can AI agents take over?

The index rates every one of 18,796 occupational task statements for how much of it a current AI agent could carry out, from helping a person to finishing the job alone, and carries the ratings to 433 occupations and 146 countries.

## Richer countries have more work agents can take over

Each flag is one of 146 countries. The ADI rises 7.23 points per log point of GDP per capita; income alone explains 71 % of the spread.

## Full delegation peaks for tasks of about twelve minutes

The chance that an agent can finish a task end to end on its own rises with task duration up to 11.8 minutes of human work and falls for longer, multi-step tasks.

Hover or focus a dot to inspect one of the 20 task-duration bins. Very short tasks are often physical or interpersonal moments; long tasks bundle steps that still need human review.
